english_title: Proposition 2.1.1: A Monotone Unbounded Sequence with Infinitesimal Differences Is Dense Modulo 1
statement_en: If $(x_n)$ is a nondecreasing positive sequence such that $x_n\to +\infty$ and $x_{n+1}-x_n\to 0$, then the fractional parts $T_n:=\{x_n\}$ are dense in $[0,1)$.
final_code:
